title: Quality Program Structure and Governance
description: Learner can describe common organizational structures and governance models used to house and oversee a healthcare quality program.

title: Integrating Quality Functions Across Departments
description: Learner can explain how quality, risk, case/utilization management, and other functions integrate to support organizational goals.

title: Strategic Planning for Quality Initiatives
description: Learner can apply strategic planning principles (mission, vision, goals) to design a quality department's annual plan.

title: Education and Training Program Design
description: Learner can design a staff education/training plan that builds quality competencies across an organization.

title: Ethics and Codes of Conduct in Quality Practice
description: Learner can apply professional ethical principles and codes of conduct to quality management decisions.

title: Patient Advocacy and Health Equity
description: Learner can incorporate patient advocacy and health equity considerations into quality program activities.

title: Communication and Team Facilitation Skills
description: Learner can apply effective communication and meeting-facilitation techniques to lead quality teams.

title: Designing Data Collection Plans
description: Learner can design a data collection plan that specifies sources, sampling, and frequency for a quality measure.

title: Selecting and Defining Quality Measures
description: Learner can select and operationally define structure, process, and outcome measures appropriate to a quality goal.

title: Basic Statistical Concepts for Quality Data
description: Learner can calculate and interpret mean, median, standard deviation, and rates commonly used in quality reporting.

title: Control Charts and Run Charts
description: Learner can construct and interpret control charts and run charts to detect special-cause vs. common-cause variation.

title: Data Validation and Integrity
description: Learner can identify sources of data error/bias and apply validation techniques to ensure data integrity.

title: Benchmarking Performance Data
description: Learner can compare organizational performance data against internal trends and external benchmarks.

title: Using Health IT and EHR Data for Analytics
description: Learner can identify how EHR and health information technology systems support quality data extraction and analysis.

title: Data Visualization and Reporting
description: Learner can create clear dashboards and reports (graphs, tables) to communicate quality data to stakeholders.

title: Comparing Performance Improvement Methodologies
description: Learner can compare PDSA, Lean, and Six Sigma approaches and select an appropriate method for a given problem.

title: Applying the PDSA Cycle
description: Learner can plan, execute, and evaluate a Plan-Do-Study-Act cycle to test a process change.

title: Root Cause Analysis Tools (Fishbone, 5 Whys)
description: Learner can use fishbone diagrams and the 5-Whys technique to identify root causes of a process problem.

title: Pareto Analysis for Prioritization
description: Learner can apply Pareto analysis to quality data to prioritize improvement opportunities.

title: Process Mapping and Value Stream Mapping
description: Learner can create flowcharts and value stream maps to analyze current-state processes.

title: Conducting a Gap Analysis
description: Learner can compare current performance data against desired benchmarks to identify improvement gaps.

title: Developing a Performance Improvement Action Plan
description: Learner can draft an action plan with goals, owners, and timelines for a performance improvement project.

title: Change Management for PI Initiatives
description: Learner can apply change management strategies to support staff adoption of process improvements.

title: Evaluating and Sustaining Improvement Outcomes
description: Learner can evaluate post-implementation data and design controls to sustain improvement gains.

title: Managing PI Projects
description: Learner can apply basic project management principles (scope, timeline, resources) to a quality improvement project.

title: Culture of Safety Assessment
description: Learner can assess an organization's culture of safety using established survey tools and identify improvement areas.

title: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
description: Learner can conduct a proactive FMEA to identify and mitigate potential process failures before they occur.

title: Root Cause Analysis for Sentinel Events
description: Learner can conduct a root cause analysis in response to a sentinel or adverse event.

title: Designing Incident Reporting Systems
description: Learner can design an event/incident reporting system that encourages non-punitive staff reporting.

title: High-Reliability Organization Principles
description: Learner can apply high-reliability organization principles to reduce patient harm.

title: Interpreting Patient Safety Indicators
description: Learner can interpret patient safety indicator and adverse event data to identify trends.

title: Risk Mitigation Strategy Development
description: Learner can develop risk mitigation action plans based on FMEA and RCA findings.

title: Overview of Accreditation and Regulatory Bodies
description: Learner can describe the roles of CMS, Joint Commission, and other accrediting/regulatory bodies in healthcare quality.

title: Preparing for Accreditation Surveys
description: Learner can prepare an organization's documentation and staff readiness for an accreditation survey.

title: Ongoing Regulatory Compliance
description: Learner can monitor and maintain ongoing compliance with conditions of participation and regulatory standards.

title: Credentialing and Privileging Coordination
description: Learner can describe the process for coordinating provider credentialing and privileging within a quality framework.

title: Mock Surveys and Tracer Methodology
description: Learner can conduct a mock survey using tracer methodology to assess ongoing survey readiness.
